source_owners.finding: RunningCanonicalServer owns native/WT ProfileServer controls. Native+WT incoming QUIC handshakes retain a bounded slot through connection lifetime. Shutdown begins drain before awaiting owned workers.

ProfileServer::stats returns accepted/rejected/active physical counters; begin_drain stops new admission while existing peers retain normal lifetimes; no new upstream counter patch needed for these values.
WSS owns its own ProfileServer and exposes control(); raw intake try_send overflow currently drops the socket without a separate intake rejection counter.
HTTPS and loopback HTTP use distinct capacity, handshake and connection semaphores; authenticated operation and public health routes are distinct. Extend observations at actual semaphore ownership.

CanonicalRuntimeSnapshot already distinguishes physical peers, peer Session views, live Sessions, logical Connections, media readers, role projections and replacement preparations. Runtime keeps weak physical owners and owned JoinSet work.
MAX_SUBSCRIPTIONS=8 per physical owner; capacity checks precede new origin insertion; cancelled origins are pruned. Need current signed-client refusal and cleanup qualification.
Authenticated Health snapshot composes static component/reason observations and bounded numeric media callback. Extend the existing surface, retaining minimal public health.
Readiness schema has state/components/media; no current operational resource snapshot field.

Limits declares participants, physical/logical connection budget, message/upload/storage/receipt/Session bounds. Need explicit meaning of configured vs observed fields and no cross-transport pass inheritance.
